# autonomic_replay_divergence_refusal

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Refuses replay when recomputed state or receipt identity diverges from the admitted evidence.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actuation_id` | `string` | yes | Unique bounded actuation identity. |
| `subject_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact caller-local subject commit SHA. |
| `authority_receipt_sha` | `string` | yes | Immutable receipt admitting authority for this transition. |
| `state_digest` | `string` | yes | Deterministic state digest used by verification and replay. |
